answers.how: The acorn is about 117 px wide. Fitting its free fall gives approximately 14,000 px/s², so gravity sets the scale at 0.070 cm/px.
The acorn’s tip-to-stem height is about 150 px; multiplying by the gravity-derived scale of 0.070 cm/px gives 10.5 cm.
The fitted trajectory gives a speed near 2,400 px/s at 1.40 s. The gravity-derived scale is 0.00070 m/px.
At 1.40 s, the gap along the fall direction from the acorn’s bottom to the chair’s impact level is approximately 333 px, at 0.070 cm/px.
At 1.80 s, the bottom-to-chair gap along the gravity direction is approximately 305 px, at 0.070 cm/px.
The acorn’s center moves approximately 181 px between 1.30 s and 1.40 s. Multiplying by 0.070 cm/px gives its displacement.
